states: 20 final synthetic-response controls use the real existing Overview/Notifications components, hooks, API adapters, toast and CSS. Desktop Chromium 141.0.7390.37/light and phone WebKit 26.0/dark; Playwright 1.56.1 matches the integration lock.

Both Retry and Dismiss, accepted and rejected while pending, then view replacement: no late toast/feedback or new health/activity GET; the replacement remains independently healthy. Pending controls are disabled and one confirmation leads to one synthetic POST.

This is mounted-view lifetime acceptance, not full-shell/in-place organisation replacement, real queue/provider delivery, native use, publication or release acceptance. An already-issued action is neither cancelled nor undone on unmount.

A keyed fixture replacement unmounts the actual old component and mounts the same existing surface with independent health evidence, without page reload. Held responses then complete through the production API client.

Read and POST budgets, global toast calls, fixed local feedback, replacement heading/state and viewport width are asserted. No notification is sent; all HTTP is synthetic local evidence. Screenshots fast-forward CSS animation only to inspect settled rendering.
